retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle, desaturated vintage photograph of a wooden rollercoaster structure against a cloudy sky with centered, high-contrast modern typography.
excludeWhen: minimalist flat vector art is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a low-angle shot of a white wooden rollercoaster track curving across the lower half, set against a vast, overcast sky with soft, teal-tinted clouds. The image has a weathered, film-like quality with a subtle dark vignette and a thin, irregular border. Centered in the upper half is a two-tier typographic block using a heavy, high-contrast serif for the primary text and a wide-spaced sans-serif for the secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: Structural complexity of the coaster vs. the open expanse of the sky
Heavy black typography anchored in the negative space of the clouds
Muted, cool-toned palette contrasted by stark black lettering
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of scale and nostalgia
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the structure
Centered vertical alignment for all text elements
Soft-focus or film grain texture throughout

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The rollercoaster occupies the bottom 60% of the frame, curving from the bottom left toward the center right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, black display text centered in the upper third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the coaster track upward, then rests on the centered text block in the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper 40% of the frame is primarily cloudy sky, providing a clean backdrop for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and pale teal (sky and clouds)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed tonal range, favoring mid-tones and highlights with deep black accents.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure white; use cream or light grey

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast modern serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses extreme stroke contrast (thick verticals, thin horizontals)
Secondary text uses uniform stroke weight and wide letter spacing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'p' and 'r' with rounded, ball-like terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif paired with a minimalist, wide-tracked sans-serif for a modern-vintage look.

preserve: High stroke contrast in the serif

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme stroke contrast and ball terminals of the display text.
Provides the clean, geometric skeleton needed for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of a vintage white wooden rollercoaster structure against a cloudy, teal-tinted sky. Apply a desaturated film-grain filter and a subtle dark vignette around the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center the primary text in a heavy, high-contrast lowercase serif font in the upper third of the image. Directly below it, add the secondary text in a light, all-caps geometric sans-serif with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the rollercoaster structure wooden and white?
Is the sky desaturated with a teal/cool tint?
Is the primary text lowercase and high-contrast?
Is the secondary text uppercase and widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the teal color grade
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific 'parachute' logo or band name
Do not replicate the exact cloud patterns
Do not use the specific 'Losing Sleep' title

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the sky

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Ensure the vignette does not obscure the coaster details.
Verify the serif font has distinct thick and thin strokes.
Confirm the overall mood is nostalgic and slightly melancholic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle vintage architecture + desaturated sky + centered high-contrast serif typography.
